chunks: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent [a message] to Muawiya ibn Abi Sufyan: Know that Satan has prevented you from turning to the best of your affairs, and listening to the words of your counsel. And peace be upon its people.

key_terms.أَحْسَنَ أُمُورِكَ: The best of your affairs / actions

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to Muawiya about Satan's influence on his actions?
ai.summary: In this epistle to Muawiya ibn Abi Sufyan, Imam Ali (AS) diagnoses the root of political and spiritual stagnation as the devil's ability to paralyze the will, preventing the return to one's highest potential (ahsan umurihi). This reflects the Shia concept of 'waswasa' not merely as temptation, but as a debilitating force that creates inertia against self-correction and accepting counsel. The address highlights the personal responsibility of leaders to overcome internal spiritual obstacles to fulfill their external duties.
